adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff replaces `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` plus explicit `console.error(...)` logging on failure with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. The new helper throws immediately when `!success` (see `parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`), so the subsequent spread `...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data)` is effectively redundant/dead given the helper’s current behavior. Also, the prior detailed logging of the zod error and MS response was removed in this file, and the helper throws a generic `Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")`, which does lose diagnostic context compared to the old code. This is a concrete maintainability/observability regression, but not a directly verifiable functional defect from the diff alone.
